name: To-do
author: ViberDock
description: A short to-do list. The tile shows how many things are still open; a click opens the list, where a click ticks a thing off (or back on), the × deletes it, + Add types a new one and Clear done removes the ticked ones. Each item keeps its own list; give two items the same List id to share one.

settings.label: Show the list's name beside the count
settings.description: Writes the name (below) after the number on a top or bottom dock. Off by default.

settings.label: Name
settings.description: The list's name in the popup (and beside the count when shown).

settings.label: List id
settings.description: Empty: this item's own list. Items with the same id (on any dock or the desktop) show one shared list.

settings.label: Font
settings.description: The count's font: a font family installed on this PC. Empty: Segoe UI.

settings.label: Box colour
settings.description: The check box. Transparent (#00000000): the theme's text colour.
